attribution_limitations: Chest X-ray laterality: the text reads "interpreted as infiltrates, left-sided accompanied by a matching positive retrocardial air bronchogram", where "left-sided" may describe the infiltrates or only the retrocardial air bronchogram, while Table 2 says "X-ray with bilateral infiltrates" and the Figure 2 caption names no side. Decision: an ambiguity of wording scope, not a source conflict; the text sentence states no time of its own, and its laterality word is not unambiguously attached to the infiltrates.

Table 2 is introduced only by a general pointer ("The clinical timeline is summarized in Table 2"). That pointer does not make an individual text value and a Table 2 cell the same measurement, so text and Table 2 statements are kept as separate items (e.g. text 'Initial laboratory tests' creatinine 6.77 vs Table 2 Day 1 creatinine 6.77; text serology 'during the second week after admission' vs Table 2 Day 14; text creatinine 2.70 vs Table 2 Day 12-14). They are grouped in one event only where both name the same time point (admission, day 1 X-ray, day 2 CT, day 24 discharge).

The case is called "ANCA-negative" because MPO- and PR3-ANCA stayed negative by ELISA, while indirect immunofluorescence showed a low-titer pANCA of 1:32 rising to 1:320; both results are recorded as stated.

The authors state it remains unclear whether F. tularensis triggered the glomerulonephritis and interpret it as an immunological manifestation in the context of tularemia-associated sepsis; this is hedged interpretation, not an asserted cause.

Hemodialysis is listed by session days in the text ("on days 1–3, 5, 7, 9, and 11") and as Day 1 initiation and Day 12-14 trial withdrawal in Table 2; the text sentence says the sessions 'were required', but the listed session days are taken as a literal statement that they took place.

Table 3 lists published tularemia cases with kidney involvement plus a "Present case" row; only the present-case row belongs to this patient, and the literature rows (and the systematic review in the text) are not patient facts.

Corticosteroid taper: the text says corticosteroids were "successfully tapered over the following months" and Table 2 says "~Month 5 | Clinical course: corticosteroids fully tapered"; the text item is read as a completed taper without a time, and the approximate Month 5 belongs to the Table 2 item only.
